verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Shopify POS has developer surfaces: POS UI extensions, target APIs, and extensions that can query the GraphQL Admin API via fetch(). None of it documents a downloadable machine-readable spec such as an OpenAPI file or GraphQL schema/introspection export. The llms.txt probe is a documentation guide for AI crawlers, not an API spec, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
